caption: The drawing depicts a square textile design filled with floral and botanical patterns. The background is dark, almost black, creating a strong contrast with the intricate, colorful motifs. The primary objects are vertical wavy bands of blue, interwoven with red flower clusters and green stems. These vertical elements are decorated intermittently with larger, prominent cream-colored flowers with hints of pink and red in the petals, as well as small white, beige, and pink blossoms scattered throughout. The design is symmetric and shows repeated motifs of elongated blue leaves, red and pink flowers, cream buds, and curled brown leaves. The composition is dense, with little negative space, and the colors primarily include shades of blue, red, pink, cream, green, brown, and black. The edges of the square feature repeating forms with red beads or fruit-like shapes strung together, outlined with curved blue foliage. The bottom left corner of the border has the printed label "Etoin Maguette."
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
